name: webcoder
description: Collaborative interview coding pad supporting Python, JavaScript, C++, Java, Go, and Rust with isolated container execution

scripts.build:sandbox: podman build -t webcoder-sandbox:latest ./sandbox || docker build -t webcoder-sandbox:latest ./sandbox
scripts.build:vscode: podman build -f sandbox/vscode.Dockerfile -t webcoder-vscode:latest ./sandbox || docker build -f sandbox/vscode.Dockerfile -t webcoder-vscode:latest ./sandbox
